title: C15 models
description: Catalog row c15-models 1.0.0: the C15 models artifact (buckets, the CMF Annex 1 table, floors, thresholds, curve fits, calibration targets, behavioural fits).

c15Label.description: A non-empty bilingual label (an empty string is not a label).

c15Sign.description: Sign convention, stated in the document: a positive delta EVE or delta NII is a loss (SRP31.129; dossier 01 H.4).

c15Units.description: Units of every number: money in the stated scale of its currency, rates as decimals discounted continuously (SRP31.129), shocks in basis points, bucket midpoints in years, dates ISO.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c15ShockSize.description: The shock sizes applied to a currency, in basis points. A tabled size is exactly the table's (SRP31.90 Table 2, d368 Annex 2 Table 1, RAN 21-13 Annex 1 Hoja 9); a currency without an entry in the BCBS table (CLP is in neither) passes only labelled as a Contraste estimate with its method, never as a regulatory parameter (dossier 01 H.3), and a tabled currency cannot be relabelled as an estimate.

weight.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c15Tranche.description: A rolling tranche of the replicating portfolio and its weight.

items.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c15Window.description: The weights re-estimated on one estimation window, in the order of the tranches (stability across windows).

c15DepositBeta.description: Deposit beta (pass-through of the market rate to the client rate), asymmetric in the direction of the move.

c15NmdModel.description: The static replicating portfolio of one NMD category at one valuation date (dossier 05 D.3). The weighted average maturity of a rolling tranche of maturity m is m / 2 (BCBS 368 footnote 38). A margin volatility the fit lacks is null with its reason.

bucket.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).

midpoint_years.description: Bucket midpoint in years: one of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3.

c15BucketDef.description: One of the 19 time buckets of SRP31.96 Table 3.

core_share_cap.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c15NmdCap.description: SRP31 Table 4 cap of a category.

c15Gamma.description: SRP31.119 Table 5 prepayment multiplier of a shock.

c15UMult.description: SRP31.125 Table 6 term-deposit early redemption multiplier of a shock.

c15Multipliers.description: The scenario multipliers of the prepayment rate and the term-deposit redemption rate, in the order of the six shocks.

c15NmdCaps.description: The three SRP31 Table 4 caps, exactly the table's.

c15Bank.description: The synthetic Banco Andino, calibrated to CMF aggregates (U5's calibration); fixtures say so.

c15TableRow.description: A row of the Annex 1 Hoja 9 shock table; '-' in the source is null.

c15CurveModel.description: The curve fit of one BCCh series family (labelled as an adaptation).

cpr_base.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c15Prepayment.description: The base prepayment behaviour (CPR, or a PSA multiple of the 100 percent PSA curve).

reporting_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c15Fit.description: C15 models: the 19 buckets, the CMF Annex 1 table, floors and thresholds as data, the offset share and the indexation rate, the BCCh curve fits, the Banco Andino calibration targets and the behavioural fits.
